ModMetaData.name: Raiders Have Families
ModMetaData.author: Pavuchicha
ModMetaData.description: Raiders Have Families 0.3.0 EXPERIMENTAL for RimWorld 1.7. Expanded families, a nine-tier social/political rank system, hostage negotiations and faction retaliation. Separate assault and tactical prison-rescue responses, optional field extraction pod prototype, exact optional WCE2 surgery integration. Event-driven Harmony 3. Some advanced scenarios remain in development. Back up saves before testing.
